signedOut.title: Sign in to continue
signedOut.body: {{name}} ({{host}}) is asking to read your data in JoyoRogo. Sign in to your JoyoRogo account, then you can see exactly what it asks for before you allow it.

invalid.title: This request can't be used
invalid.body: The address of this page is incomplete or not valid. Start again from the AI app: remove the JoyoRogo connector there, add it again, then tap Connect.
invalid.expiredBody: A permission request is only valid for 10 minutes. Start again from the AI app by tapping Connect on the JoyoRogo connector.

client.verify: The name is sent by the app itself. Only allow it if the address above is the app you actually use.
client.loadError: We couldn't load the app's details. Try again.

scopes.title: What it can read
scopes.offline: Stays connected for 30 days, until you disconnect it.
scopes.none: This app isn't asking to read any data.

notes.readOnly: Read only: it can't change or delete anything in your account.
notes.dataFlow: Your data goes to this AI app and the provider you chose, only when you ask a question in your account there. Their privacy terms apply to that data.
notes.disconnect: You can disconnect it any time in AI connections, and its access stops at once.
notes.health: Health data here is not medical advice.

pro.body: AI connections are a JoyoRogo Pro feature. You can connect now, but the AI app can only read your data once Pro is active.

error.consent: We couldn't save your choice. Try again, or start over from the AI app.
error.expired: This request has expired. Start again from the AI app.
